items.description: On PowerPC, fctiw/fctiwz on a NaN writes 0x80000000 to the low word of frD (checked on a real Wii in GameCube mode). The interpreter does this explicitly, and Jit64 gets it from CVTPD2DQ. JitArm64 uses FCVTZS, which returns 0 for a NaN. Fixes https://bugs.dolphin-emu.org/issues/14136 (Super Monkey Ball: Banana Blitz). I don't have an ARM64 device,
items.triage_reason: GitHub開発情報
